original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚参议院议长助手与青年领袖警告勿让青年被政客利用为暴徒
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚参议院议长Godswill Akpabio的立法助手Dauda Makama、尼日利亚全国青年理事会及其他利益相关方警告青年，不要在2027年大选前被政客利用充当暴徒。他们呼吁尼日利亚青年远离政治暴力、了解自身权利并积极参与选举进程，强调政治分歧不应导致敌意、流血或生命财产损失。上述表态于周六在卡杜纳州Sabon Tasha的Wusili Tourist Hotel举行的政治宣传活动上作出。该报道目前为单一来源。

location.raw_text: Wusili Tourist Hotel, Sabon Tasha, Kaduna State

key_facts.fact: 参议院议长助手与青年领袖警告青年勿在2027年大选前被政客利用为暴徒
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Dauda Makama, the legislative aide to the President of the Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the National Youth Council of Nigeria and other stakeholders have warned youths against allowing politicians to use them as thugs ahead of the 2027 general elections.

key_facts.fact: 活动在卡杜纳州Sabon Tasha的Wusili Tourist Hotel举行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The stakeholders spoke on Saturday at a political sensitisation programme organised by the Bajju Youth Catholic Organisation at Wusili Tourist Hotel, Sabon Tasha, Kaduna State.

key_facts.fact: 呼吁青年远离政治暴力并积极参与选举进程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They urged young Nigerians to shun political violence, understand their rights and participate actively in the electoral process

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
报道为部分正文提取，信息可能不完整
